context: A bakery chain's operating margin fell from 18% to 9% in two years. The CEO wants to know which cost to tackle first.
chart_title: Costs as a share of revenue
key_insight: labor rose 7 points of revenue, most of the 9-point margin fall, so labor is the cost to tackle first
chart_figures: Labor rose 7 points (28% to 35%); Ingredients rose 1 point; Delivery rose 1 point; Rent flat at 12%; Total cost rise 9 points
model_answer: Labor explains most of the margin fall: it rose from 28% to 35% of revenue, 7 of the 9 points lost, so labor is where the CEO should start.
